{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.06

|gr1= Radio and Chat

|descr= A getter for [[enableSentences]].

|s1= [[sentencesEnabled]]

|r1= [[Boolean]] - returns [[true]] if sentences are enabled

|x1= <sqf>
if (sentencesEnabled) then
{
	hint "sentences are enabled; changing that now";
	enableSentences false;
};
</sqf>

|seealso= [[enableSentences]]
}}
